name: Pér (Hungary)
description: Three vertical stripes of blue, white and blue in the ratio 1:2:1, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Pér (a blue shield with white ploughshares, a scythe, a wavy stripe and a fish) below the name PÉR in black.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
